historical_reviews.deepseek: Maps Cd to a generic cdrom token but does not identify the medium, prove the boot marker, protect credentials, read back scope or eject and restore.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly binds the operation to a specific optical source and keeps installer or disk-write activity outside the unapproved boot test.
historical_reviews.history: No earlier exact source identity record exists.
historical_reviews.v3_1: The key discriminator is media provenance across two layers: the firmware must select the optical-class device and the bytes executed must match the approved physical disc or virtual image. A cdrom override alone proves neither.

original_test_intent: Validate that the BMC's enabled one-time CD setting boots the approved SUT from the intended physical or virtual optical medium and then leaves media and normal boot state cleanly restored.
original_method: Identify the exact optical device or VirtualMedia instance and immutable medium/image, validate checksum/signature and boot-mode compatibility, capture boot baseline, obtain approval, set/read back the protected one-time CD override, reboot once under POST/console observation, prove the approved non-writing boot marker, then eject or detach the medium, confirm override consumption and restore the normal OS path.
manual_activity: The owner approves the exact optical source and reboot; an operator observes POST/console, prevents installer writes and controls medium removal, restoration, recovery and verdict.
required_inputs: Physical optical device or VirtualMedia resource
UEFI or legacy optical boot compatibility
Baseline boot order and current media state
safety_requirements: Do not assume cdrom selects the intended medium
Verify immutable media identity before setting boot
Use protected credentials and one-time scope
Stop on wrong media, installer, disk-write prompt, boot failure or timeout
Eject or detach media and clear the override
agent_execution_scope: Validate optical source identity and integrity
Apply/read back one approved one-time CD setting after confirmation
Request and perform one approved reboot
Collect structured state while operator proves POST/console boot marker
Verify media removal, override consumption and normal OS recovery
engineer_actions: Approve exact medium, marker and maintenance window
Observe correct medium and prevent disk writes

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: bootdev cdrom expresses only an optical class; the literal command exposes credentials, resets immediately and does not establish medium identity, boot mode, one-time readback, observed marker or eject/restore.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the vendor-supported protected one-time CD control after binding the optical source to an approved immutable medium, then correlate readback, POST and its non-writing boot marker before eject and restoration.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Cd, Enabled/Save, reboot and 10/20-minute estimates remain; specific path becomes the approved optical medium and boot marker.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record the medium hash or physical label/serial, attached optical resource, boot override readback, POST device selection, executed boot marker and final ejected/detached state in one evidence chain.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the unnamed optical source auditable and requires cleanup without changing the requested CD boot.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A bootdev response cannot show which inserted image was selected, and an attached image cannot show that firmware executed it.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A stale virtual image or physical installer disc can boot successfully but violate the intended source and may automatically write disks if not stopped at the defined marker.

project_override_considerations: The Project must choose physical versus virtual optical media, its exact identity and safe boot landmark. The copied PXE regression note does not replace CD-specific acceptance and is not treated as PXE coverage here.
expected_evidence: Approved target/window, optical resource and immutable medium identity/integrity, boot mode and baseline order
Protected one-time CD write/readback and exact media attachment state
Reset plus POST/console timeline proving the approved non-writing boot marker
Proof no installer or disk write occurred
Media eject/detach, consumed override and original OS restoration
Health, audit/SEL/OS logs, recovery actions and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and procedure consistently require CD boot. The specific path is the project-selected optical medium, while the PXE note is copied regression context rather than a competing CD target.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The exact medium, mapping, marker and recovery package are normal owner/vendor inputs; execution remains gated until supplied but the purpose is identifiable.

review_improvement: Converts a generic optical-class reset into proof that one approved medium actually booted and was removed without leaving a persistent override or installation side effect.
independent_technical_reasoning: Optical boot selection and optical content identity are independent assertions. Firmware can select a virtual CD device holding stale media, or fall back after a failed optical attempt. The post marker must therefore originate from the approved medium and be correlated with POST selection, while final detach prevents future unintended boots.
